text:
Asha Patel: Heads up — GroveAI symposium next Wed. We need final preflight for the joint demo (Redwood Private + EdgeBox). Can we lock speaker slots, demo failover, and swag drop?

Liam Chen: I can own demo routing and failover. Plan: primary to private (us-west), fallback to hosted Redwood API if load spikes. Will test KV cache warmup and model cold-start.

Marisol Ortega: I'll run speaker coordination and slide handoff. Are we bundling a marketplace announcement with Grove? Need marketing copy deadline.

Ben Hart: Shipping update — dev kits ready. Manifest SKU RDW-GROVE-DEVKIT (qty 12). Courier is ShipQuick, ETA venue Tue 10:00. Sending tracking + customs docs later today.

Sophie Kim: AV note — bring HDMI adapters, USB-C dongles, and 1x NVIDIA->HDMI on EdgeBox. Who is the onsite volunteer for setup?

Liam Chen: @Ben can you confirm customs for EU? Quick healthcheck for EdgeBox: `curl -s http://10.0.5.7:8080/health | jq '.status'` — expecting \"ok\".

Ben Hart: Sent customs paperwork to ShipQuick. Tracking: https://shipquick.example/track/ABC12345. Onsite deliverer: Kai, +1-555-0102.

Marisol Ortega: Speaker flow (draft): 10:00 intro, 10:10 Grove demo, 10:25 Redwood infra handover, 10:35 Q&A. Final slide deck by Mon EOD please.

Asha Patel: Swag plan — 120 sticker packs, 60 shirts (L/M/S split), 40 enamel pins. Pack list in Drive: `SWAG-PACKING-LIST.xlsx`. Also want a small meetup table sign that says "Redwood x GroveAI".

Sophie Kim: For reliability, prep a 2-min pre-recorded demo clip on S3 as backup. If live demo latency >30s or error rate >1%, switch to clip.

Liam Chen: I'll set canary routing: 80% private, 20% hosted. Adding per-route token budget in console. Test script for load check:

```
# simple load test
for i in {1..50}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}'; done
```

Marisol Ortega: Grove marketing wants a joint tweet T+1h after the session. Draft: "Excited to showcase GroveAI + Redwood Inference at Grove Symposium — live demo & deep dive." Need legal signoff before publish.

Ben Hart: Confirmed ShipQuick will clear customs if we attach commercial invoice + manifest. I'll deliver PDFs to the ShipQuick portal tonight.

deploy-bot: Reminder: rehearsal scheduled Mon 16:00 UTC — calendar invites sent.

Asha Patel: Action items: @Liam — run failover test by Mon. @Ben — confirm customs + morning check-in with ShipQuick by Mon noon. @Marisol — finalize slides + tweet copy by Mon EOD. @Sophie — prepare pre-record clip + AV checklist. Please reply with :thumbsup: when done.
